title: Kata Persona Forge
tagline: A character, from the inside out.
description: A local-first character workshop with distinct adult face presets, an optional A-line skirt with garment-only bones and hem sway, weighted posing and editable GLB export.
features: Three distinct adult face presets plus the preserved original three
Nine additional fitted face controls, from head proportions to lips
CC0 MakeHuman anatomical adult with original portrait detail maps
Neutral studio lighting, iris tint and reflective cornea
Fitted brows and lashes with facial morphs
Textured swept short crop and bald option
53-bone weighted skeleton and four static bone-driven poses
Optional original A-line skirt with nine garment-only auxiliary bones
Hem-sway control, body-build fit morphs and editable garment export
Twenty-eight editable appearance morph targets plus pose correctives
Height scaling and preserved garment/pose fixes
Locally bundled Three.js and labeled software preview
Body and close face inspection with profile framing
PNG preview and editable project downloads
limitations: Stylized procedural hair, not photorealistic or a production groom
Synthetic skin detail and tinting of one diffuse skin source
No facial animation or cloth simulation
Skirt fit is checked across supported static poses; arbitrary bone edits may clip
